SELECT t.*, AS stockStatus FROM ( SELECT p.product_id AS productId, IFNULL(ps.sku_id, 0) AS skuId, p.product_name AS productName, ps.sku_value AS productSkuName, p.pic_thumb AS productPicThumb, p.product_sn AS productSn, ps.sku_sn AS skuSn, p.product_tsn AS productTsn, p.shop_id AS productShopId, sp.shop_id AS storeShopId, p.product_related AS productRelated, r.id AS ruleId, r.warn_enabled AS warnEnabled, r.lower_limit AS lowerLimit, r.upper_limit AS upperLimit, r.update_time AS updateTime,
CASE WHEN #{query.useStoreStock} AND sp.store_product_id IS NOT NULL AND ps.sku_id IS NOT NULL THEN CASE WHEN #{query.useTotalStock} THEN LEAST(IFNULL(sps.sku_stock, 0), IFNULL(ps.sku_stock, 0)) ELSE IFNULL(sps.sku_stock, 0) END WHEN #{query.useStoreStock} AND sp.store_product_id IS NOT NULL THEN CASE WHEN #{query.useTotalStock} THEN LEAST(IFNULL(sp.product_stock, 0), IFNULL(p.product_stock, 0)) ELSE IFNULL(sp.product_stock, 0) END WHEN ps.sku_id IS NOT NULL THEN IFNULL(ps.sku_stock, 0) ELSE IFNULL(p.product_stock, 0) END AS currentStock, IFNULL(pt.transitStock, 0) AS transitStock FROM product p LEFT JOIN product_sku ps ON ps.product_id = p.product_id LEFT JOIN store_product sp ON sp.product_id = p.product_id AND sp.shop_id = #{query.shopId} LEFT JOIN store_product_sku sps ON sps.store_product_id = sp.store_product_id AND sps.product_sku_id = ps.sku_id LEFT JOIN stock_warning_rule r ON r.product_id = p.product_id AND r.sku_id = IFNULL(ps.sku_id, 0) AND r.shop_id = #{query.shopId} AND r.is_delete = 0
LEFT JOIN ( SELECT poi.product_id AS productId, poi.sku_id AS skuId, SUM(GREATEST(poi.quantity - IFNULL(poi.received_quantity, 0), 0)) AS transitStock FROM purchase_order_item poi INNER JOIN purchase_order po ON po.id = poi.order_id WHERE po.is_del = 0 AND poi.is_del = 0 AND po.type = 1 AND po.status IN (1, 2) AND po.shop_id = #{query.shopId} GROUP BY poi.product_id, poi.sku_id ) pt ON pt.productId = p.product_id AND pt.skuId = IFNULL(ps.sku_id, 0) WHERE p.is_delete = 0 AND p.vendor_id IS NULL AND (p.shop_id = #{query.shopId} OR sp.shop_id = #{query.shopId})
AND (p.product_id, IFNULL(ps.sku_id, 0)) IN
(#{target.productId}, #{target.skuId})
AND p.product_type = #{query.productType}
AND ( p.product_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.keyword}, '%') OR p.product_sn LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.keyword}, '%') OR ps.sku_sn LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.keyword}, '%') )
) t
= #{query.stockStatus}
AND t.warnEnabled = 1
AND t.warnEnabled = #{query.warnEnabled}
ORDER BY
t.currentStock ASC t.currentStock DESC
t.transitStock ASC t.transitStock DESC
t.lowerLimit ASC t.lowerLimit DESC
t.upperLimit ASC t.upperLimit DESC
t.productId DESC , t.skuId ASC
mapper.select: SELECT p.product_id AS productId, p.product_name AS productName, ps.sku_value AS skuValue, p.vendor_id AS vendorId, CASE WHEN #{useStoreStock} AND sp.store_product_id IS NOT NULL AND #{skuId} > 0 THEN CASE WHEN #{useTotalStock} THEN LEAST(IFNULL(sps.sku_stock, 0), IFNULL(ps.sku_stock, 0)) ELSE IFNULL(sps.sku_stock, 0) END WHEN #{useStoreStock} AND sp.store_product_id IS NOT NULL THEN CASE WHEN #{useTotalStock} THEN LEAST(IFNULL(sp.product_stock, 0), IFNULL(p.product_stock, 0)) ELSE IFNULL(sp.product_stock, 0) END WHEN #{skuId} > 0 THEN IFNULL(ps.sku_stock, 0) ELSE IFNULL(p.product_stock, 0) END AS currentStock FROM product p LEFT JOIN product_sku ps ON ps.product_id = p.product_id AND ps.sku_id = #{skuId} LEFT JOIN store_product sp ON sp.product_id = p.product_id AND sp.shop_id = #{shopId} LEFT JOIN store_product_sku sps ON sps.store_product_id = sp.store_product_id AND sps.product_sku_id = #{skuId} WHERE p.product_id = #{productId} LIMIT 1
